title: Alshaya Group opens 15 brand stores at Aventura Mall - Kuwait’s newest shopping destination
summary: The opening featured a diverse mix of prominent global brands

contentHtml:
Aventura Mall - Kuwait. Image Courtesy: Alshaya Group

The opening featured a diverse mix of prominent global brands

Press Release

Kuwait: Leading international retail franchise operator Alshaya Group has today opened of 15 stores at the new Aventura Mall, Kuwait’s vibrant retail and lifestyle destination designed to bring together shopping, dining, and social experiences in one dynamic environment.

The opening featured a diverse mix of prominent global brands including Starbucks, Foot Locker, H&M, Raising Cane’s, Shake Shack, Chipotle, Victoria’s Secret, Bath & Body Works, and Boots. 

Commenting on the opening, John Hadden, Chief Executive Officer of Alshaya Group, said: “As a vibrant new addition to Kuwait's retail landscape, Aventura Mall perfectly aligns with our vision to deliver innovative, unforgettable experiences that delight our customers. We are thrilled to celebrate the official opening of Aventura Mall, marking another major step in our commitment to bringing world-class brands and premier dining and shopping experiences directly to our customers. We invite everyone to visit and enjoy the unique experiences we have created here."

Over the coming weeks and months, visitors can look forward to additional openings such as Ulta Beauty’s second location in Kuwait, American Eagle, P.F. Chang’s, and Kuwaiti restaurant Amiti Noura, alongside new first in market innovative entertainment concepts like Supercube, Zafari, and Activerse, with Primark scheduled to open its doors in January 2027.

Located in Jaber Al-Ahmad City, the Aventura project reflects a forward-looking vision for urban development in Kuwait. It is one of the community-focused developments currently being implemented under a public-private partnership (PPP) model. The project is led by Mabanee Company as the main investor, in partnership with National Industries Company (NIC) and Privatization Holding Company.

The development aims to create a new destination with a contemporary identity, offering a dynamic, modern lifestyle that brings together the essential elements of a vibrant urban environment. This development includes the residential component Aventura Residences, Aventura Mall, and a variety of public facilities and services.

 Designed according to international standards, Aventura Mall is set to become a modern landmark in Jaber Al-Ahmad City, attracting visitors from across Kuwait. The mall will host a diverse selection of global retail brands, restaurants, and cafés, delivering a distinctive and engaging shopping and entertainment experience.

About Alshaya Group

Alshaya Group is a dynamic family-owned business, first established in Kuwait in 1890. With a consistent record of growth and innovation, Alshaya Group is one of the world’s leading brand franchise operators, offering an unparalleled choice of over 50 well-loved, international brands to customers.  

Alshaya Group’s portfolio extends across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Eurasia and Europe, with over 3,500 stores, cafes, restaurants, and leisure destinations, major logistics and food production operations, as well as over 125 online and digital businesses including one of the region’s biggest retail loyalty programmes, Aura.      

Operating in multiple sectors including Fashion, Food, Health & Beauty, Pharmacy, and Hospitality & Entertainment, over 50,000 Alshaya colleagues are united by a commitment to authentically deliver great customer service and brand experiences.  Alshaya Group is recognised in the top 25 of the Great Place to Work® 2026 World’s Best Workplaces™ List.   

From flagship stores and restaurants in prestige malls, through to local coffee shops, drive-thrus and online, Alshaya Group brings customers the experiences they want with the brands they love, in the ways they choose - including American Eagle, Bath & Body Works, Charlotte Tilbury, Chipotle, Footlocker, H&M, Primark, Raising Cane’s, Shake Shack, Starbucks, Ulta Beauty and Victoria’s Secret. Learn more about Alshaya Group at www.alshaya.com Media enquires: diala.nahle@alshaya.com
